Main
Image reference: assets/2026-08-31_why-handysize-matters-diversified-trades-limited-supply-and-revised-valuations_img_rgb-color-brs-shipbrokers-monogram-l_c365f35f1de5.png
The dry bulk spot market has remained firm of late, encouraging owners to consider further investment in new tonnage. Although Handysizes (37,000-43,999 dwt) remain somewhat peripheral in the broader dry bulk market with lower liquidity than Supramaxes, fewer transactions than Kamsarmaxes and less market-grabbing attention than Capesizes, the segment's underlying supply-demand fundamentals appear to be improving. Another notable market feature is the gradual upsizing of the Handysize design.
